description: The dashboard's Settings panel is the only place that checks for and installs updates (a 'Check for Updates' row) — scoped to that window only, same one-capability-file-per-concern pattern as pill-drag.json/pill.json. process:allow-restart is the one follow-up action an installed update needs (the JS API is named relaunch(), but the underlying permission/command tauri-plugin-process exposes is 'restart').
